targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
In the zones
furthest from sources of propagules and/or dominated by invasive
species, planting native species of diﬀerent functional groups can be an
eﬀective strategy for accelerating the recovery of the structure and of
certain species of the TMCF, while in the zones adjacent to mature
forests, recovery of some structural characteristics can take place with
the simple exclusion of disturbance.
targeting_gate.rationale: Author gives spatial prescription for passive versus active restoration by distance to propagules and invasive dominance, not merely describes measured performance.

key_findings: One qualitative passive-strategy distance direction; no calibrated distance cutoff.
Additional invasive-dominance active-selection clause retained on ontology/scope hold.
holds: Regional single-landscape inference; human review and distance variable pending ontology review.
Invasive dominance clause not forced to land_cover or species envelope.
completion_boundary: Source-purpose screening and documented passages only; no claim of complete main-paper/supplement extraction, source sweep, human approval or executable mapping.
